overview.text: Trump condemned California Gov. Newsom's commutation of hundreds of death sentences in a Justice Department speech on violent crime.
Iran vowed to end the U.S. naval blockade by all available means, while Trump said Iranian attacks have done no damage.
Three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland, and NATO's Rutte is working to reassure eastern allies as incursions rise.
Video of ICE agents arresting a father and daughter at Seattle airport has drawn outrage, with some flight crew asking to be replaced.
Measles poses a growing risk to U.S. adults, including some vaccinated people born before 1989, experts say.
CrowdStrike agreed to buy Zscaler in a $44 billion deal combining two major cybersecurity firms.

stories.headline: Trump targets Newsom over death sentence commutations in Justice Department speech
stories.summary: President Trump condemned California Gov. Gavin Newsom's decision to commute hundreds of death sentences. The speech at the Justice Department focused on violent crime and targeted Democrats.

stories.headline: Iran vows to end U.S. naval blockade by 'all available means'
stories.summary: Iran said it will force the U.S. to lift its blockade. Trump acknowledged Iran's increasing attacks but said they have "done no damage."
stories.why: Rising confrontation at sea could escalate the conflict.

stories.headline: ICE arrest of father and daughter at Seattle airport sparks outrage
stories.summary: An ICE arrest was filmed as passengers boarded an Alaska Airlines flight. Some crew members asked to be replaced because the event was so distressing.
stories.why: It raises questions about how immigration agents carry out arrests in public places.

stories.headline: Russian incursions into NATO territory increase after missiles land in Poland
stories.summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is seeking to reassure eastern European members after three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday.
stories.why: Spillover from the war in Ukraine is testing the alliance.

stories.headline: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok generating child sex images
stories.summary: State attorneys general say Grok is still producing child sexual abuse material and revenge porn. X says every Grok output is screened.
stories.why: It tests how AI image tools are held accountable.

stories.headline: Measles is a growing risk for U.S. adults
stories.summary: Danger is greatest for the unvaccinated, but medical experts say vaccinated people born before 1989 may no longer be sufficiently protected.
stories.why: Some adults may want to check their vaccination status with a doctor.

stories.headline: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler in $44 billion cybersecurity deal
stories.summary: The two major cybersecurity firms will combine as worries grow over hacks fueled by advances in artificial intelligence affecting companies and governments.

stories.headline: SEC schedules vote on possible LSU expulsion
stories.summary: LSU's standoff with the SEC over the RJ Luis dispute has escalated into a legal and political fight, with major penalties still possible.
